# E0104: a version file imports a package

A version file imports nothing. A schema is written with CUE's builtins alone,
so that every version of a lineage is self-contained.

## Example

`ship/0.0.thema`:

```cue
import "strings"

schema: {
	a: strings.MinRunes(1)
}
```

thema reports:

```
error[E0104]: 0.0.thema imports a package
 --> 0.0.thema:1:1
  |
1 | import "strings"
  | ^^^^^^
  |
  = help: a version file imports nothing; a schema uses only CUE's builtins
```
